title: AI-assisted ultrasound for dating pregnancy
summary: Prospective study of 385 pregnant women in Chicago and Nairobi: the model estimates gestational age from scans taken by minimally trained operators with a mean error of 4.18 days, non-inferior to the 4.48 days of expert sonographers. This is a non-inferiority result from only two sites, both relatively urban.
ai_technology: Ultrasound model for estimating gestational age
